Definition: Galed, a memorial cairn East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Galeed is the heap of witness, the pile of stones Jacob and Laban raised between them. Jacob called it Galeed in Genesis 31:47, and Laban said in Genesis 31:48 that this heap is a witness between me and thee this day. The name means heap of witness, and the stones stood as a boundary neither man would cross to harm the other.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God sets stones as witnesses between men who cannot trust each other. Jacob and Laban parted with a heap between them, and I hold that a boundary kept in peace is better than a quarrel won.
